items.title: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes and Factors Associated With Response in Older Adults With Massive Irreparable Rotator Cuff Tears: A Four-Year Prospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A four-year prospective cohort study with 92 older adults with atraumatic massive irreparable rotator cuff tears (MIRCTs) found that most patients (95-100%) achieved minimal clinically important differences (MCID) with nonoperative treatment, persisting until 4 years. Longer symptom duration (β = -1.3; 95% CI = -1.7 to -0.8) and smoking (β = -8.8; 95% CI = -13.2 to -4.4) were associated with worse shoulder function.
items.curatedReason: 对于老年、无法修复的巨大肩袖撕裂（MIRCTs）患者，非手术治疗是有效的长期方案，95-100%的患者在四年内能达到MCID。别再犹豫将非手术治疗作为此类患者的一线选择，但要提醒患者，症状持续时间长和吸烟可能导致更差的功能预后。
items.titleZh: 老年不可修复巨大肩袖撕裂患者的长期临床结局及影响因素：一项四年前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对92名老年非创伤性不可修复巨大肩袖撕裂（MIRCTs）患者进行的四年前瞻性队列研究发现，大多数患者（95-100%）通过非手术治疗达到了临床最小重要差异（MCID），效果持续至四年。症状持续时间越长（β = -1.3; 95% CI = -1.7至-0.8）和吸烟（β = -8.8; 95% CI = -13.2至-4.4）与较差的肩关节功能相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults with massive irreparable rotator cuff tears (MIRCTs), nonoperative treatment is an effective long-term option, with 95-100% of patients achieving MCID over four years. Don't hesitate to consider nonoperative management as a first-line option for these patients, but be aware that longer symptom duration and smoking may be associated with worse functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心前瞻性队列研究，且大部分患者（76/92）在3个月内表现出临床改善，可能存在选择偏倚，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective cohort study, and the majority of patients (76/92) showed clinical improvement within 3 months, which may introduce selection bias and limit generalizability.

items.title: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 37 studies found very low certainty evidence regarding whether reduced spinal range of motion is an independent prognostic factor for pain intensity, disability, or global recovery in people with specific or nonspecific spinal pain. Most studies reported inconsistent or no clear associations.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述发现，脊柱活动度受限与脊柱疼痛患者的疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复之间的关联尚不明确，证据确定性极低。你在临床评估时，应避免过度依赖脊柱活动度作为独立预后指标，而需结合更多临床信息进行综合判断。
items.titleZh: 脊柱活动度受限是否为特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复的预后因素？一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含37项研究的系统综述发现，关于脊柱活动度受限是否为特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复的独立预后因素，证据确定性极低。大多数研究报告的结果不一致或无明确关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that the association between reduced spinal range of motion and pain intensity, disability, and global recovery in people with spinal pain is unclear due to very low certainty evidence. In clinical assessment, you should avoid over-relying on spinal ROM as an independent prognostic indicator and instead integrate it with other clinical information for a comprehensive judgment.
items.limitation: 纳入的37项研究均存在高偏倚风险，且结果存在异质性，导致证据确定性极低。
items.limitationEn: All 37 included studies had a high risk of bias and showed heterogeneity in results, leading to very low certainty of evidence.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Do treatment parameters of dry needling influence its effect on pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 23 studies (out of 5,220 identified) found no consistent evidence that dry needling parameters (number of sessions, trigger points, local twitch responses) influenced its effectiveness for neck pain. Meta-regressions did not identify these parameters as moderators (QM = 0.26, p = 0.968 to QM = 3.17, p = 0.205).
items.curatedReason: 干针治疗颈痛时，目前没有证据表明治疗参数（如疗程次数、激痛点数量、局部抽搐反应）会影响疗效。所以，你暂时不需要纠结于这些具体剂量参数，重点仍应放在干针的整体临床效果和患者的个体反应上。
items.titleZh: 干针治疗参数是否影响其止痛效果？一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含23项研究（从5,220项中筛选）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，没有一致证据表明干针治疗参数（疗程次数、触发点数量、局部抽搐反应）会影响其对颈痛的疗效。荟萃回归分析也未发现这些参数是疗效的调节因素（QM = 0.26, p = 0.968 至 QM = 3.17, p = 0.205）。
items.curatedReasonEn: There is currently no evidence that dry needling parameters (e.g., number of sessions, number of trigger points, local twitch responses) influence its effectiveness for neck pain. Therefore, you do not need to overthink these specific dosage parameters for now; continue to focus on the overall clinical effect of dry needling and individual patient responses.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的大部分文献报告不完整且存在高偏倚风险，荟萃分析存在显著异质性，导致无法得出可靠的剂量-反应关系。
items.limitationEn: Most included literature had incomplete reporting and high risk of bias, and the meta-analysis showed substantial heterogeneity, preventing identification of a reliable dose-response relationship.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Patients' experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 14 postpartum women in Sweden found that telerehabilitation for pelvic floor dysfunction was perceived as a complementary approach, improving accessibility and flexibility. However, participants also expressed concerns about the absence of physical examination and hands-on guidance.
items.curatedReason: 产后盆底功能障碍的远程康复，患者认为它能提高可及性和灵活性，是面诊的良好补充。但在设计远程方案时，你需要正视患者对缺乏体格检查和手法指导的顾虑，考虑如何通过混合模式（线上线下结合）来弥补这些不足。
items.titleZh: 产后盆底功能障碍患者参与物理治疗远程康复的体验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对瑞典14名产后女性进行的定性研究发现，盆底功能障碍的远程康复被视为一种补充性方法，提高了可及性和灵活性。然而，参与者也表达了对缺乏体格检查和实际指导的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: Postpartum women perceive telerehabilitation for pelvic floor dysfunction as a complementary approach that improves accessibility and flexibility. However, when designing telerehabilitation programs, you must address patient concerns about the absence of physical examination and hands-on guidance, considering how hybrid models (blended in-person and online care) can mitigate these shortcomings.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（14名参与者），结果主要反映瑞典初级保健环境下的患者经验，因此外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size (14 participants) and primarily reflects patient experiences in a primary healthcare setting in Sweden, limiting generalizability.

items.title: A Machine Learning Model With Temporal Validation for Predicting Walking Ability in Nontraumatic Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: A machine learning model using Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) was developed to predict walking ability in 148 nontraumatic spinal cord injury patients. It achieved an AUC of 0.91 (95% CI: 0.77-1.00) on internal testing and 0.81 accuracy (95% CI: 0.68-0.92) on temporal external validation (n=37). Key predictors included lower limb muscle strength and age.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究初步开发了一个机器学习模型，用于预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力。虽然模型在内部和外部验证中表现良好，但目前仍处于探索阶段，你在临床上不应将其作为现成的工具。它提示了未来精准康复评估的潜力，但仍需等待更大规模、多中心研究的验证。
items.titleZh: 基于时间验证的机器学习模型预测非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力
items.summaryZh: 一个使用梯度提升决策树（GBDT）的机器学习模型被开发用于预测148名非创伤性脊髓损伤患者的步行能力。该模型在内部测试中实现了0.91的AUC（95% CI: 0.77-1.00），在时间外部验证（n=37）中实现了0.81的准确率（95% CI: 0.68-0.92）。关键预测因素包括下肢肌力和年龄。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study preliminarily developed a machine learning model to predict walking ability in patients with nontraumatic spinal cord injury. While the model showed promising performance in internal and external validation, it is still exploratory, and you should not use it as a ready-to-use clinical tool. It suggests the potential for future precise rehabilitation assessment but requires validation in larger, multicenter studies.
items.limitation: 本模型在单中心、相对较小的患者群体（148例开发，37例外部验证）中开发和验证，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: The model was developed and validated in a single center with a relatively small patient cohort (148 for development, 37 for external validation), limiting generalizability.

items.title: Psychometric Evaluation of the Parental Education in Physiotherapy Scale: A Brief Measure of Family-Centered Educational Practices in Pediatric Physiotherapy.
items.summary: The Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale, an 8-item, 3-factor measure (Collaboration, Capacity-Building, and Reflection), demonstrated excellent psychometric properties (CFI = 1.000, RMSEA = 0.011, SRMR = 0.031) among 310 Spanish pediatric physical therapists for assessing family-centered educational practices.
items.curatedReason: 这份8项的“物理治疗中的家长教育量表”（PEP）在西班牙儿科物理治疗师中验证了其评估家庭中心教育实践的优异心理测量学特性。你可以用这个量表来定期评估和指导自己在与6岁以下儿童家庭合作、赋能和反思方面的表现，从而系统性地提升家庭中心化护理质量。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗中家长教育量表的心理测量学评估：一项关于儿科物理治疗中家庭中心化教育实践的简短测量工具
items.summaryZh: “物理治疗中的家长教育量表”（PEP）是一项包含8个条目、3个维度（协作、能力建设和反思）的测量工具，在310名西班牙儿科物理治疗师中表现出优秀的心理测量学特性（CFI = 1.000, RMSEA = 0.011, SRMR = 0.031），用于评估以家庭为中心的教育实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: The 8-item Parental Education in Physiotherapy (PEP) scale has demonstrated excellent psychometric properties among Spanish pediatric physical therapists for assessing family-centered educational practices. You can use this scale to regularly evaluate and guide your performance in collaborating with, building capacity in, and reflecting with families of children under 6 years of age, thereby systematically improving the quality of family-centered care.
items.limitation: 本研究为工具性横断面研究，数据来源于西班牙的物理治疗师，可能存在文化和实践背景的局限性。
items.limitationEn: This instrumental cross-sectional study collected data from physical therapists in Spain, which may introduce cultural and practice context limitations.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Trends in Australia's physiotherapy workforce: changes and future implications.
items.summary: An 11-year analysis of Australia's physiotherapy workforce (2013-2023) showed a 70.5% increase in physiotherapists, from 21,046 to 35,889, but an persistent maldistribution with 81.0% practicing in metropolitan areas in 2023. Males were 15% less likely to practice in regional centers than females (OR 0.85, p < .001), while Indigenous physiotherapists were 85% more likely to practice in regional centers (OR 1.85, p < .001).
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力在过去 11 年增长了 70.5%，但乡村和偏远地区的分配不均问题依然存在。规划师们可以以此为依据，更精准地制定激励措施和支持策略，以吸引更多 PT 到这些地区执业。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力的趋势：变化与未来影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力 11 年（2013-2023）的分析显示，物理治疗师数量从 21,046 增至 35,889，增长了 70.5%，但劳动力在乡村和偏远地区的分配不均问题依然存在，2023 年 81.0% 的 PT 在大都市执业。男性在区域中心执业的可能性比女性低 15%，而原住民物理治疗师在区域中心执业的可能性高 85%。
items.curatedReasonEn: Australia's physiotherapy workforce grew by 70.5% over 11 years, yet maldistribution in rural and remote areas persists. Planners can use this data to precisely design incentives and support strategies to attract more PTs to practice in these regions.
items.limitation: 本研究基于横断面数据和回顾性分析，未能探讨劳动力流动的动态原因。
items.limitationEn: This study relies on cross-sectional data and retrospective analysis, limiting its ability to explore dynamic reasons for workforce mobility.

items.title: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial (n=60) found that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG), when combined with conventional physical therapy, significantly improved upper-limb motor function (ARAT scores: 12.05-point gain for SES, 12.44-point gain for Alt-EMG, P < .001 for both) in chronic stroke patients over 12 weeks, compared to conventional therapy alone. No significant difference was observed between SES and Alt-EMG.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性卒中患者手功能康复，感觉电刺激 (SES) 和交替肌电图引导电刺激 (Alt-EMG) 两种疗法都显著优于单独的常规物理治疗。这意味着你可以在常规治疗基础上，更自信地将这两种电刺激方法纳入方案，提升患者上肢运动功能，但二者之间并无明显优劣。
items.titleZh: 慢性卒中手功能康复中感觉电刺激与交替肌电图引导电刺激疗效的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，对于慢性卒中患者，结合常规物理治疗的感觉电刺激（SES）和交替肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG）在12周内均显著改善上肢运动功能（SES 组 ARAT 评分平均增加 12.05 分，Alt-EMG 组增加 12.44 分，两组 P < .001），优于单独常规治疗，但 SES 和 Alt-EMG 之间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic stroke hand function recovery, both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) significantly outperform conventional physical therapy alone. This means you can confidently integrate either SES or Alt-EMG into your existing protocols to improve upper-limb motor function, as neither shows a clear advantage over the other.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（每组 20 人），且仅随访了 12 周，长期疗效和更大人群的普适性尚需更多研究。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (20 per group) and only followed participants for 12 weeks, requiring further research for long-term efficacy and generalizability to larger populations.

items.title: First aggression as a planning signal in post-acute stroke rehabilitation: Service benchmarks, goal setting, and a 60-day precaution window from a comprehensive observational cohort.
items.summary: This retrospective observational study (N=1683) in a tertiary neurorehabilitation hospital found that a first EHR-documented aggression after stroke signals longer length of stay (+17.9 days), lower motor Functional Independence Measure (mFIM) outcomes, and higher risks of urinary tract infection and falls. The incidence of first aggression was 2.83/1000 patient-days, with 30-day and 60-day risks of 8.1% and 15.6% respectively, justifying a 60-day precaution window for planning.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后康复期间首次出现攻击性行为是一个重要的预警信号，预示着患者康复周期更长、功能预后更差，且伴随其他并发症风险升高。这为你的临床规划提供了具体的时间窗和目标设定依据：一旦发生攻击性行为，应将此作为一个规划信号，实施 60 天的预防窗口期，并相应调整康复目标和出院预期。
items.titleZh: 首次攻击性行为作为卒中后急性期康复规划信号：服务基准、目标设定和 60 天预防窗口期（来自一项综合观察性队列研究）
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性观察研究（N=1683）在一家三级神经康复医院发现，卒中后首次电子健康记录中记载的攻击性行为预示着更长的住院时间（+17.9天）、更低的运动功能独立性评定（mFIM）结果，以及更高的尿路感染和跌倒风险。首次攻击性行为的发生率为2.83/1000患者天，30天和60天风险分别为8.1%和15.6%，这支持将60天作为规划预防窗口期。
items.curatedReasonEn: A first aggression episode during post-stroke rehabilitation is a significant warning sign, indicating longer rehabilitation, poorer functional outcomes, and increased risk of complications. This provides concrete planning benchmarks for your clinical practice: treat it as a planning signal, implementing a 60-day precaution window, and adjusting rehabilitation goals and discharge expectations accordingly.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性单中心观察性队列研究，可能存在混杂因素，且结果需要在多中心环境中进行验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective, single-center observational cohort study, subject to confounding and requiring multicenter validation.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: A normative torque-profile approach for quantifying elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance after stroke: a proof-of-principle study
items.summary: This proof-of-principle study introduces ScoreE, a novel isokinetic dynamometry-derived metric for quantifying elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance after stroke. ScoreE showed good to excellent inter-rater (ICCs 0.81-0.89) and test-retest (ICCs 0.76-0.93) reliability, superior to MAS, and moderate associations with MAS grades, offering a reliable, objective, and visually interpretable assessment for post-stroke spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究引入了一种新的客观评估方法 ScoreE，通过等速测力学量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌高阻力，相比传统 MAS 具有更好的可靠性。这意味着你未来可能拥有更客观、可视化的工具来监测卒中患者的痉挛管理效果，辅助你进行精准康复干预。
items.titleZh: 一种量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌高阻力的规范扭矩曲线法：概念验证研究
items.summaryZh: 这项概念验证研究引入了 ScoreE，一种新的等速测力学指标，用于量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌的高阻力。ScoreE 显示出良好至优秀的评价者间（ICC 0.81-0.89）和测试-再测试（ICC 0.76-0.93）可靠性，优于 MAS，并与 MAS 分级呈中度相关，为卒中后痉挛提供了一种可靠、客观且可视化可解释的评估方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-principle study introduces ScoreE as a new method to quantify elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance post-stroke, showing superior reliability compared to the traditional MAS. This suggests it could offer a more objective and reliable tool for spasticity quantification, but larger, prospective studies are needed to validate its utility in guiding treatment decisions and predicting outcomes before it can replace MAS as a clinical gold standard.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（本研究纳入了三十五名卒中患者），且未进行响应性评估，因此其在检测干预效果方面的表现尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (thirty-five stroke patients were included in this study) and did not assess responsiveness, so its ability to detect intervention effects remains unclear.

items.title: "It's important, but at a cost…": healthcare professionals and people with aphasia describe what influences use of a novel, digital communication aid.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored healthcare professionals' (HCPs) and people with aphasia's (PWA) experiences with a novel digital communication aid. HCPs valued the app for person-centered care but faced constraints from clinical demands and lack of healthcare system support, suggesting that multi-level systems reform is needed to facilitate communication aid adoption for PWA.
items.curatedReason: 沟通障碍是卒中后失语患者面临的关键挑战，而数字沟通辅助工具的使用虽有价值，却受到临床、沟通和情感等多重需求的限制。在引入此类工具时，需意识到仅靠工具本身不足以解决问题，更重要的是医疗系统层面的支持和文化转变，例如增加培训和资源配置。
items.titleZh: “这很重要，但有代价”：医疗专业人员和失语症患者描述了什么影响了新型数字沟通辅助工具的使用
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了医护人员 (HCP) 和失语症患者 (PWA) 使用新型数字沟通辅助工具的经验。HCP 认为该应用对以患者为中心的护理很有价值，但受到临床需求和医疗系统支持不足的限制，这表明需要多层面的系统改革来促进失语症患者沟通辅助工具的采用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Communication barriers are a key challenge for post-stroke aphasia patients, and while digital communication aids are valuable, their use is limited by a complex interplay of clinical, communicative, and emotional demands. When introducing such tools, recognize that the tool itself is insufficient; systemic support and cultural shifts, such as increased training and resource allocation, are more crucial.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性观察性研究，样本量很小（10 名医疗专业人员和 3 名失语症患者），结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative observational study had a very small sample size (10 HCPs and 3 PWAs), limiting generalizability.

items.title: Appraisals of life transition events and associations with quality of life at 3- and 12-months post-discharge following spinal cord injury.
items.summary: This longitudinal observational study (n=47 at 3-months, n=39 at 12-months) found that for adults with spinal cord injury, positive appraisals of life transition events (e.g., return-to-work, driving) and coping efficacy were consistently and positively associated with better quality of life (EUROHIS-QoL-8) at 3 and 12 months post-discharge, after controlling for event occurrence.
items.curatedReason: 对于脊髓损伤患者，生命转折事件（如重返工作或驾驶）的积极评价以及应对能力的自我效能感，与出院后 12 个月的良好生活质量显著相关。这意味着你需要关注患者对这些事件的主观意义和应对策略，通过提升自我效能和提供资源，帮助患者更好地适应，而不仅仅是关注功能恢复本身。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤患者出院后 3 个月和 12 个月生命转折事件评价与生活质量的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项纵向观察性研究（3个月随访时n=47，12个月随访时n=39）发现，对于脊髓损伤成年患者，对生命转折事件（如重返工作、驾驶）的积极评价和应对效能感，在控制了事件发生后，与出院后3个月和12个月的较好生活质量（EUROHIS-QoL-8）持续呈正相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: For spinal cord injury patients, positive appraisals of life transition events (e.g., returning to work or driving) and self-efficacy in coping are significantly associated with better quality of life up to 12 months post-discharge. This means you should focus on the subjective meaning patients attribute to these events and their coping strategies, enhancing self-efficacy and providing resources to help them adapt, beyond just focusing on functional recovery.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（3 个月随访时 n=47，12 个月时 n=39），且为单中心研究，限制了结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (n=47 at 3-month, n=39 at 12-month follow-up) and was single-center, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Development of Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH): A complex Intervention to Monitor and Support Self-Management of Post-Stroke Psychological Changes Within a Matched Care Model.
items.summary: The Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH) program is a brief, complex intervention designed to monitor and support self-management of post-stroke psychological changes within the UK matched care model. Developed via a literature review, interviews, Delphi survey, and workshops, it supports stroke survivors with mild to moderate cognitive changes, low mood, anxiety, and fatigue through personalized psychoeducation and three brief reviews.
items.curatedReason: ENRICH 干预方案为卒中后心理变化的监测和支持提供了一个结构化的自我管理模型。虽然该方案仍在可行性测试阶段，但其设计思路值得你了解和借鉴，尤其是它强调分级护理和早期干预轻中度心理问题的策略，这可能有助于你更系统地整合心理支持到康复流程中。
items.titleZh: 卒中后心理变化增强型评估 (ENRICH) 的开发：一项监测和支持卒中后心理变化自我管理的分级护理复杂干预
items.summaryZh: 卒中后心理变化增强型评估 (ENRICH) 项目是一项复杂的短期干预措施，旨在英国分级护理模式下监测和支持卒中后心理变化的自我管理。该方案通过文献回顾、访谈、德尔菲调查和研讨会开发，通过个性化心理教育和三次简短评估，为有轻中度认知改变、情绪低落、焦虑和疲劳的卒中幸存者提供支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ENRICH intervention offers a structured self-management model for monitoring and supporting post-stroke psychological changes. While still in feasibility testing, its design insights are valuable, particularly its emphasis on stepped care and early intervention for mild-to-moderate psychological issues, which can help you integrate psychological support more systematically into your rehabilitation process.
items.limitation: 本研究仅报告了干预方案的设计和开发过程，尚未进行临床有效性测试，因此无法评估实际疗效。
items.limitationEn: This study only reported the design and development of the intervention, with no clinical effectiveness testing yet, thus actual efficacy cannot be assessed.

items.title: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study.
items.summary: A longitudinal observational study (n=16,783) using the SCI Model Systems database found that lower time-updated social integration (hazard ratio [HR] 1.09 per 10-point decrease) and within-person decline (HR 1.077 per 10-point decrease) were associated with higher subsequent all-cause mortality after traumatic spinal cord injury. Associations were seen for natural (HR 1.08) and external mortality (HR 1.11).
items.curatedReason: 这项大型队列研究揭示了脊髓损伤患者较低的社会融合水平和随时间推移的下降与更高的死亡风险相关。这提醒你在康复规划中不能仅关注躯体功能，还需重视患者的社会融合度，并考虑社会支持干预作为长期管理策略的一部分。
items.titleZh: 时间变化的社会融合与创伤性脊髓损伤后长期全因和特定原因死亡率：一项纵向 SCIMS 研究
items.summaryZh: 一项使用脊髓损伤模型系统数据库的纵向观察性研究（n=16,783）发现，创伤性脊髓损伤后，较低的时间更新社会融合度（每下降 10 分，风险比 [HR] 1.09）和个人内部下降（每下降 10 分，HR 1.077）与后续较高的全因死亡率相关。自然原因（HR 1.08）和外部原因（HR 1.11）死亡率也观察到相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large cohort study reveals that lower and declining social integration in spinal cord injury patients are associated with a higher mortality risk. This emphasizes the need for you to consider social integration, not just physical function, in rehabilitation planning, and to incorporate social support interventions as part of long-term management strategies.
items.limitation: 研究设计为观察性队列研究，无法确定因果关系，且存在幸存者选择偏差和部分死亡原因缺失。
items.limitationEn: As an observational cohort study, it cannot establish causality, and survivor selection bias and missing causes of death limit interpretation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

related.title: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study

items.title: The Current State of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: Graft Selection, Lateral Augmentation, Rehabilitation, and Return-to-Play.
items.summary: This review describes the current state of ACL reconstruction, highlighting a shift in graft utilization (quadriceps tendon autograft increased to ~20% by 2023) and supporting lateral extra-articular tenodesis for selected high-risk knees. It emphasizes a move from fixed timelines to criteria-based return-to-play (RTP), with psychological readiness independently associated with RTP and second ACL injury, and calls for validation of RTP criteria against reinjury endpoints.
items.curatedReason: 关于 ACL 重建的综述强调了移植物选择、侧方加固、康复和重返运动（RTP）策略的最新进展。你会发现，RTP 决策已从固定时间转向基于标准的评估，并且心理准备度与再次损伤风险独立相关。这意味着在患者管理中，需要更个性化地选择移植物，并全面评估功能和心理因素，不能仅依赖时间。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建的现状：移植物选择、侧方加固、康复和重返运动
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述描述了前交叉韧带重建的现状，强调移植物使用（股四头肌腱自体移植物在 2023 年增至约 20%）的转变，并支持为特定高危膝关节进行侧方关节外腱固定术。它强调重返运动 (RTP) 已从固定时间转向基于标准的评估，心理准备度与 RTP 和第二次 ACL 损伤独立相关，并呼吁针对再损伤终点验证 RTP 标准。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review on ACL reconstruction highlights the latest advancements in graft selection, lateral augmentation, rehabilitation, and return-to-play (RTP) strategies. You will find that RTP decisions have shifted from fixed timelines to criteria-based assessments, and psychological readiness is independently associated with reinjury risk. This means your patient management should involve more personalized graft selection and a comprehensive assessment of both functional and psychological factors, moving beyond time-based criteria.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择性偏倚，并未对证据质量进行系统性评估和综合。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias and does not systematically appraise and synthesize evidence quality.

items.title: Photobiomodulation therapy has a negligible effect as an adjunct to motor control exercise in people with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised trial.
items.summary: A randomized trial (n=148) found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise (MCE) for chronic non-specific low back pain had a negligible effect on pain intensity (MD -0.4 points, 95% CI -1.2 to 0.4) and disability (MD -0.7 points, 95% CI -2.4 to 0.9) at 6 weeks and over 12 months, compared with sham PBMT plus MCE.
items.curatedReason: 针对慢性非特异性腰痛，在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）的额外收益微乎其微。不要将其作为常规辅助手段，而应将重心放在主动运动上。
items.titleZh: 慢性非特异性腰痛中光生物调节疗法作为运动控制训练辅助手段的效果微乎其微：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机试验（n=148）显示，在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）对慢性非特异性腰痛患者的疼痛强度（MD -0.4分, 95% CI -1.2至0.4）和功能障碍（MD -0.7分, 95% CI -2.4至0.9）在6周及12个月随访期内效果微乎其微，与假PBMT加运动控制训练相比无临床重要性改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic non-specific low back pain, adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise offers negligible additional benefits. Do not prioritize it as a routine adjunct; focus on active exercise.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明患者的疼痛病程与具体的运动控制训练方案，可能影响结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the patients' pain chronicity or specific motor control exercise protocols, which might affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Efficacy of physiotherapy in reducing pain in subjects with temporomandibular disorders: a systematic review with network meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis (25 RCTs, n=1,540) found manual therapy (MT) and therapeutic exercise (TE) effective for reducing pain in temporomandibular disorders (TMDs). Multimodal treatments were most effective, with the combination of dry needling and manual therapy appearing to be the best approach.
items.curatedReason: 对于颞下颌关节紊乱病（TMDs）患者的疼痛管理，手法治疗（MT）和治疗性运动（TE）应作为一线干预。当选择组合疗法时，干针与手法治疗结合似乎是最有效的。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱病患者疼痛中的疗效：一项带网络荟萃分析的系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析（25项RCT，n=1,540）发现，手法治疗（MT）和治疗性运动（TE）在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱病（TMDs）患者疼痛方面有效。多模式治疗效果最佳，其中干针与手法治疗的结合似乎是最有效的方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: For pain management in temporomandibular disorders (TMDs), manual therapy (MT) and therapeutic exercise (TE) should be first-line interventions. When combining therapies, dry needling with manual therapy appears to be the most effective approach.
items.limitation: 本网络荟萃分析纳入的研究异质性较高，方法学质量参差不齐（PEDro评分3-9分），可能影响总体效应量的稳健性。
items.limitationEn: This network meta-analysis included studies with high heterogeneity and varying methodological quality (PEDro scores 3-9), which may affect the robustness of the overall effect sizes.

items.title: From information to action; co-designing pain neuroscience education for adolescents with low back pain: Focus group insights.
items.summary: Focus group discussions with 15 adolescents (15-19 years old) with low back pain revealed four key themes for co-designing pain neuroscience education (PNE): need for recognition ("This is about me"), practical tools ("What can I do myself?"), engaging format ("Otherwise I will stop reading"), and easy navigation ("It must be easy to find").
items.curatedReason: 青少年腰痛患者需要针对性的疼痛神经科学教育（PNE），强调可操作的策略和引人入胜的内容呈现方式。在设计PNE材料时，优先考虑他们的需求和偏好。
items.titleZh: 从信息到行动；为青少年腰痛患者共同设计疼痛神经科学教育：焦点小组洞察。
items.summaryZh: 通过与15名青少年（15-19岁）的焦点小组讨论，本研究确定了共同设计青少年腰痛疼痛神经科学教育的四个关键主题：需求认可（“这是关于我的”）、实用工具（“我能自己做什么？”）、引人入胜的格式（“否则我会停止阅读”）以及易于导航（“必须容易找到”）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adolescents with low back pain need tailored pain neuroscience education (PNE) that emphasizes actionable strategies and engaging content delivery. Prioritize their needs and preferences when designing PNE materials.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小，且仅限于访谈形式，可能无法全面反映所有青少年患者的偏好和需求。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study had a small sample size and relied solely on interviews, which may not fully capture the preferences and needs of all adolescent patients.

items.title: Early Changes in Post-Stroke Quality of Life and Associated Factors: A Prospective Study.
items.summary: A prospective study of 111 stroke patients found that physical HRQoL improved progressively over 3 months, while mental HRQoL improved only in the first month. Functional ambulation was associated with physical HRQoL change (β = 0.483, p < 0.001), and depressive symptom severity with mental HRQoL change (β = -0.692, p < 0.001).
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期康复规划时，要分别关注身体和心理层面的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。步态功能与躯体HRQoL关联度高，而抑郁症状严重程度则与心理HRQoL变化密切相关。
items.titleZh: 卒中后生活质量的早期变化及相关因素：一项前瞻性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项对111名卒中患者的前瞻性研究发现，卒中后3个月内身体健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）持续改善，而心理HRQoL仅在第一个月有所改善。步态功能与身体HRQoL变化相关（β = 0.483, p < 0.001），抑郁症状严重程度与心理HRQoL变化显著相关（β = -0.692, p < 0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: During early post-stroke rehabilitation planning, focus on physical and psychosocial health-related quality of life (HRQoL) separately. Ambulation is highly associated with physical HRQoL, while depressive symptom severity is strongly linked to mental HRQoL changes.
items.limitation: 该前瞻性研究的样本量相对较小，且随访时间仅为3个月，可能无法捕捉到长期HRQoL的变化及影响因素。
items.limitationEn: This prospective study had a relatively small sample size and only a 3-month follow-up, which may not capture long-term HRQoL changes and influencing factors.

items.title: Recent highlights in pulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.summary: This narrative review highlighted five key themes in pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) research from January 2021 to May 2026: improving access, uptake, and completion; extending PR beyond stable COPD to other chronic respiratory diseases; developing alternative PR models; maintaining benefits post-PR; and economic analyses of PR.
items.curatedReason: 肺康复的证据范围已大大扩展，不再仅限于稳定期慢阻肺患者，并出现了多种替代模式。应积极关注并利用这些新的证据和模式，以提升肺康复的覆盖率和效果。
items.titleZh: 肺康复研究的最新亮点。
items.summaryZh: 本叙述性综述总结了2021年1月至2026年5月肺康复（PR）研究的五个关键主题：提高PR的可及性、参与率和完成率；将PR扩展至稳定期慢阻肺以外的其他慢性呼吸系统疾病；开发替代PR模式；PR完成后的益处维持；以及PR的经济效益分析。
items.curatedReasonEn: The evidence base for pulmonary rehabilitation has expanded significantly beyond stable COPD, with various alternative models emerging. Actively explore and utilize these new evidence and models to improve the reach and effectiveness of pulmonary rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，可能存在作者选择偏倚，且未进行系统性证据质量评估，可能影响结论的客观性。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to author selection bias and lacks systematic evidence quality assessment, potentially affecting the objectivity of its conclusions.

items.title: "It's a black box": Physiotherapists' perspectives on sensorimotor control and the use of technology in this context to improve rehabilitation following ACL injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 22 physiotherapists found interest in technology for sensorimotor control assessment and rehabilitation after ACL injury, but adoption was limited by uncertainty regarding the clinical value of sensorimotor outcomes and the need for clear clinical benefits and integration with reasoning.
items.curatedReason: 尽管物理治疗师对在ACL损伤康复中整合技术以评估和训练感觉运动控制表现出兴趣，但临床价值不确定性是其普及的主要障碍。未来应关注开发具有明确临床益处和与工作流程兼容的传感器运动控制技术。
items.titleZh: “这是一个黑匣子”：物理治疗师对感觉运动控制及相关技术在ACL损伤康复中应用的看法。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对22名物理治疗师的定性研究发现，物理治疗师对在ACL损伤后应用技术进行感觉运动控制评估和康复表现出兴趣，但由于对感觉运动结果的临床价值存在不确定性，且缺乏明确的临床益处和与临床推理的整合，技术采纳受到限制。
items.curatedReasonEn: While physiotherapists are interested in integrating technology for sensorimotor control assessment and training in ACL injury rehabilitation, uncertainty about clinical value is a major barrier to adoption. Future efforts should focus on developing sensorimotor control technologies with clear clinical benefits and workflow compatibility.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，仅通过焦点小组形式收集了22位德国物理治疗师的意见，可能不具备广泛的代表性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study collected opinions from only 22 German physiotherapists through focus groups, which may not be broadly representative.

items.title: Effect of Short-Rest Interval versus Traditional Multiple-Set Resistance Training Combined with Endurance Training in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial (n=71) found that short-rest interval resistance training (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set resistance training (3×9 RT) combined with endurance training similarly improved VO₂peak and lean mass in cardiovascular disease patients. 3/7 RT showed greater improvement in isokinetic quadriceps strength (+23±20 N·m) compared to 3×9 RT (+11±22 N·m; P=0.022).
items.curatedReason: 对于心血管疾病患者，短间歇阻力训练（3/7 RT）和传统多组阻力训练（3×9 RT）在心脏康复项目中同样可行且有效，可根据患者偏好选择。但若目标是更显著的等速股四头肌力量改善，3/7 RT可能略优。
items.titleZh: 心血管疾病患者中短间歇与传统多组阻力训练结合耐力训练的效果：一项随机临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机临床试验（n=71）发现，心血管疾病患者在结合耐力训练的短间歇阻力训练（3/7 RT）和传统多组阻力训练（3×9 RT）后，VO₂peak和瘦体重改善相似。然而，3/7 RT在等速股四头肌力量方面显示出更大的改善（+23±20 N·m），而3×9 RT为（+11±22 N·m；P=0.022）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For cardiovascular disease patients, both short-rest interval resistance training (3/7 RT) and traditional multiple-set resistance training (3×9 RT) are feasible and effective in cardiac rehabilitation, allowing for patient preference. However, 3/7 RT may be slightly superior for greater isokinetic quadriceps strength improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究的强度评估集中于股四头肌，可能无法全面反映全身肌肉力量在两种训练模式下的差异。
items.limitationEn: The strength assessment in this study focused on the quadriceps, which may not fully reflect whole-body muscle strength differences under the two training modalities.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness of conservative interventions on pain and disability in degenerative cervical spine disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (2,378 participants) found that conservative interventions significantly reduced pain (SMD = −0.67) and disability (SMD = −0.60) in degenerative cervical spine disease. Acupuncture and exercise-based interventions showed significant benefits, while manual therapy did not show a significant pooled benefit. Evidence certainty was low.
items.curatedReason: 对于退行性颈椎病，保守治疗确实能改善疼痛和残疾（SMD分别达到-0.67和-0.60）。目前证据提示，针灸和运动疗法有明确益处，但手法治疗的合b并益处不显著。鉴于证据质量较低，你可以优先考虑将运动和针灸纳入治疗方案，但对单纯手法治疗的预期需保持审慎。
items.titleZh: 保守干预措施对退行性颈椎病疼痛和残疾的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 18 项 RCT（2,378 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，保守干预措施能显著减轻退行性颈椎病的疼痛 (SMD = −0.67) 和残疾 (SMD = −0.60)。针灸和运动疗法显示出显著益处，而手法治疗未显示显著的汇总益处。证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Conservative interventions do reduce pain and disability in degenerative cervical spine disease (SMDs of -0.67 and -0.60, respectively). Current evidence suggests clear benefits from acupuncture and exercise-based therapies, but manual therapy did not show a significant pooled benefit. Given the low certainty of evidence, you can prioritize incorporating exercise and acupuncture, but temper expectations for manual therapy alone.
items.limitation: 本综述存在显著异质性（I² = 87.20%），且证据确定性较低，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This review exhibits substantial heterogeneity (I² = 87.20%) and low certainty of evidence, which may affect the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 27 studies (1,177 participants) found that chronic physical exercise training improved the metabolic cost of walking (Cw) in healthy individuals (g=0.49), but not significantly in stroke patients (g=0.24, p=0.065). Higher BMI was associated with smaller intervention effects on Cw (β=-0.20). Population type moderated the effects of training on Cw (p=0.043).
items.curatedReason: 慢性运动训练能改善健康个体的步行代谢成本（g=0.49），但在卒中患者中，其改善效果并不显著（g=0.24, p=0.065）。此外，BMI越高，训练对步行代谢成本的改善效果越小（β=-0.20）。这意味着，在健康人群中，运动训练是提高步行效率的有效手段；而对于卒中患者，其效益可能较小，且肥胖会进一步削弱这种效果，设计方案时务必考虑这些差异。
items.titleZh: 运动训练对健康和疾病状态下步行代谢成本的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 27 项研究（1,177 名参与者）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，慢性体力运动训练能改善健康个体的步行代谢成本 (g=0.49)，但在卒中患者中无显著改善 (g=0.24, p=0.065)。较高的 BMI 与步行代谢成本干预效果较小相关 (β=-0.20)。人群类型调节了训练对步行代谢成本的影响 (p=0.043)。
items.curatedReasonEn: Chronic exercise training improves the metabolic cost of walking (Cw) in healthy individuals (g=0.49) but not significantly in stroke patients (g=0.24, p=0.065). Higher BMI also correlated with smaller intervention effects on Cw (β=-0.20). This means exercise training is effective for improving walking economy in healthy populations, but its benefits might be smaller for stroke patients, and obesity further attenuates this effect. Be sure to consider these differences when designing intervention plans.
items.limitation: 本综述包含的研究存在中度异质性，且卒中、多发性硬化症、帕金森病等神经系统疾病患者的样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This review includes studies with moderate heterogeneity, and the sample sizes for neurological conditions like stroke, MS, and Parkinson's disease are relatively small.

related.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.

items.title: Adherence to home-based exercise therapy in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain: a cross-sectional study of 491 participants of the ComPaRE cLBP e-cohort (ADHERE II).
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 491 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain found that adherence to home-based exercise therapy was 45%, with no significant influence of supervision. Higher baseline physical activity, lower pain intensity, and lower treatment burden were associated with higher adherence.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了慢性非特异性腰痛患者居家运动治疗依从性仅为 45%，并且未发现监督能显著提高依从性。这提示您在设计居家方案时，需要更关注患者物理活动水平、疼痛强度和治疗负担等因素。
items.titleZh: 慢性非特异性腰痛成人居家运动治疗依从性：一项包含 491 名参与者的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 491 名非特异性慢性腰痛成人进行的横断面研究发现，居家运动治疗依从性为 45%。研究未能证实监督对依从性的显著影响，但较高的基础体力活动水平、较低的疼痛强度和治疗负担与较高的依从性相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study shows that adherence to home-based exercise therapy in non-specific chronic low back pain is only 45%, with no significant influence of supervision. This suggests that when designing home programs, you need to consider factors like baseline physical activity, pain intensity, and treatment burden more closely.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study used a cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Continuity of care interventions for people with stroke and their caregivers: a scoping review of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A scoping review of 80 randomized controlled trials on continuity of care interventions for stroke patients and caregivers found most studies included only patients and focused on the transition from inpatient to home care. It highlighted the need for more family-centered interventions that include both patients and caregivers and address all transitions across the stroke care continuum.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者的连续性照护干预研究应更多地纳入患者及其照护者，并从家庭中心角度考量。这提示您在设计卒中康复方案时，应将照护者视为核心，并关注急性期后向居家过渡的连续性支持。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者及其照护者连续性照护干预的范围综述：随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述纳入 80 项随机对照试验，发现大多数卒中连续性照护干预研究仅纳入患者，并侧重于从住院到居家照护的过渡。综述强调，未来的干预研究应同时纳入卒中患者及其照护者，并采取以家庭为中心的方法，解决卒中全程护理的各种过渡需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: Continuity of care interventions for stroke patients should involve both patients and caregivers, adopting a family-centered approach. This indicates that when designing stroke rehabilitation plans, you should consider caregivers as central and focus on continuous support during the transition from acute care to home.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未能进行荟萃分析，无法量化干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that did not include meta-analysis, so it cannot quantify intervention effects.

items.title: "It's not for me": community-based fall prevention exercise programs for those aging into disability.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 11 adults aged 50+ with mobility or sensory impairments identified multidimensional barriers to participation in community-based fall prevention exercise programs. Themes included lack of awareness/access, interconnected accessibility challenges, disability experiences, and program design issues. Rebranding and co-designing inclusive, flexible programs are suggested.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示，社区跌倒预防运动项目在吸引老年残疾人群时面临多维度障碍，包括污名化、项目错位和自我刻板印象。您在设计或推广此类项目时，应考虑重新品牌定位，并采用共创设计以提升包容性和参与度。
items.titleZh: “这不适合我”：针对步入残疾老龄化人群的社区跌倒预防运动项目
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 11 名 50 岁以上有行动或感觉障碍成年人的定性研究发现，社区跌倒预防运动项目面临多维度参与障碍，包括认知度不足、可及性挑战、残疾经验和项目设计问题。研究建议重新品牌定位并共创设计包容性、灵活的项目。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals that community-based fall prevention exercise programs face multidimensional barriers in attracting older adults with disabilities, including stigma, program misalignment, and self-stereotyping. When designing or promoting such programs, you should consider rebranding and using co-design processes to foster inclusion and participation.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性设计，样本量小（11名参与者），结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (11 participants), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD.
items.summary: A prospective two-phase feasibility study found that a home-based pulmonary telerehabilitation program for COPD was technically feasible (device data agreement ≥99%) and clinically feasible (95% retention, high satisfaction). Exploratory outcomes showed increased endurance time.
items.curatedReason: 远程肺康复（PR）模式在技术和临床上均可行，设备数据传输准确，患者满意度高。这提示您在 COPD 患者康复中可考虑将远程康复作为可行方案，但大规模随机对照研究仍需进一步验证其临床疗效。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者肺部远程康复模型的技术和临床可行性
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性两阶段可行性研究发现，针对慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者的居家肺部远程康复项目在技术上（设备数据一致性 ≥99%）和临床上（95% 留存率、高满意度）均可行。探索性结果显示患者耐力时间增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study shows that a pulmonary telerehabilitation (PR) model is both technically and clinically feasible, with accurate data transmission and high patient satisfaction. This suggests you can consider telerehabilitation as a viable option for COPD patient rehabilitation, though larger randomized controlled studies are needed to further assess its clinical efficacy.
items.limitation: 本研究为可行性研究，样本量小，且缺乏对照组进行疗效评估。
items.limitationEn: This was a feasibility study with a small sample size and lacked a control group for efficacy evaluation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Predictive value of intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex monitoring for postoperative voiding dysfunction after lumbosacral spine surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex (BCR) monitoring found it feasible (94% success rate) and predictive of postoperative voiding dysfunction (POVD) after lumbosacral spine surgery. BCR showed moderate sensitivity (62%) and high specificity (99%), with a high negative predictive value of 94% for POVD.
items.curatedReason: 术中球海绵体反射（BCR）监测对腰骶椎手术后排尿功能障碍（POVD）具有高特异性和阴性预测值。这提示您在参与腰骶椎术前评估和术后康复计划时，可将 BCR 监测结果作为辅助参考，识别 POVD 高风险患者，并协助制定个体化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 术中球海绵体反射监测对腰骶椎手术后排尿功能障碍的预测价值：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项关于术中球海绵体反射（BCR）监测的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，该方法可行（成功率 94%），且能预测腰骶椎手术后的排尿功能障碍（POVD）。BCR 对 POVD 表现出中度敏感性（62%）和高特异性（99%），阴性预测值为 94%。
items.curatedReasonEn: Intraoperative bulbocavernosus reflex (BCR) monitoring shows high specificity and negative predictive value for postoperative voiding dysfunction (POVD) after lumbosacral spine surgery. This suggests that when participating in pre- and post-operative rehabilitation planning for lumbosacral spine surgery, you can use BCR monitoring results as an auxiliary reference to identify high-risk POVD patients and help develop individualized rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究纳入的 RCT 数量有限，且研究间存在异质性，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of RCTs included and the heterogeneity among studies may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy—a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study of 15,197 knee/hip osteoarthritis patients found that 58.5% reached recommended physical activity levels after digital education and exercise therapy. Four physical activity trajectories were identified, with BMI and physical function being key associated factors. All trajectories showed clinically comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 数字化教育和运动疗法能使约 60% 的膝/髋骨关节炎患者达到或维持推荐的体力活动水平，且不同体力活动轨迹的患者在患者报告结局（PROs）上均有可比的改善。这提示您在 OA 管理中，应持续推广数字化教育与运动疗法，并可针对 BMI 较高和功能较差的患者制定个性化策略。
items.titleZh: 数字化教育和运动疗法后体力活动轨迹：一项包含 15,197 名膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 15,197 名膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究发现，经过数字化教育和运动疗法后，58.5% 的患者达到了推荐的体力活动水平。研究识别出四种体力活动轨迹，其中 BMI 和身体功能是主要相关因素。所有轨迹的患者报告结局均有临床可比的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Digital education and exercise therapy enabled about 60% of knee/hip osteoarthritis patients to achieve or maintain recommended physical activity levels, with comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes (PROs) across different physical activity trajectories. This suggests that in OA management, you should continue to promote digital education and exercise therapy, and tailor strategies for patients with higher BMI and poorer function.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，不能排除混杂因素对结果的影响。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational cohort study, and confounding factors influencing the results cannot be excluded.

items.title: Return to Competition and Career Sustainability After Primary ACL Reconstruction in Football: A Nationwide Cohort Study of Long-Term Participation
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study of 10,836 football players after primary ACLR found a 58.5% return to competition (RTC) rate. Post-RTC career sustainability (median 31 matches over 3 seasons) was greatest among top-level players (97 matches over 5 seasons) and men (33 matches over 4 seasons vs. women's 29 matches over 3 seasons). RTC alone provides an incomplete description of participation.
items.curatedReason: 足球运动员在初次 ACLR 术后重返赛场（RTC）率达 58.5%，但职业生涯持续性因竞技水平和性别而异。这提示您在 ACLR 康复中，RTC 并非终点，应关注术后长期参与度，并根据患者的竞技水平和性别制定差异化的重返运动及职业可持续性策略。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员初次 ACL 重建术后重返赛场及职业生涯可持续性：一项全国性长期参与队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 10,836 名足球运动员初次 ACL 重建术后的全国性队列研究发现，重返赛场 (RTC) 率为 58.5%。RTC 后职业生涯可持续性（中位数 3 个赛季 31 场比赛）在顶级水平运动员（5 个赛季 97 场比赛）和男性（4 个赛季 33 场比赛对比女性 3 个赛季 29 场比赛）中最高。RTC 本身不能完全描述长期参与度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The return to competition (RTC) rate after primary ACLR in football players is 58.5%, but career sustainability varies by competitive level and sex. This suggests that in ACLR rehabilitation, RTC is not the endpoint; you should focus on long-term participation and tailor return-to-sport and career sustainability strategies based on the player's competitive level and sex.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，可能存在未测量的混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study, and unmeasured confounding factors may exist.

items.title: Physiotherapy management of persistent pelvic pain.
items.summary: A review of physiotherapy management for persistent pelvic pain, providing insights for clinical practice.
items.curatedReason: 持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗手段仍在发展。这篇综述从多维度更新了该领域的证据，值得你花时间梳理，用以优化你的临床治疗方案和拓宽干预思路。
items.titleZh: 持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述探讨了持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理，为临床实践提供了新的视角和干预策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physiotherapy for persistent pelvic pain is an evolving field. This review updates the evidence from multiple dimensions; it's worth your time to review it to optimize your clinical treatment plans and broaden intervention strategies.

items.title: Financial burden, non-medical drivers of health, and early caregiving role formation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 16 studies found that stroke caregiver assessments inconsistently capture financial toxicity and non-medical drivers of health (NMDOH). Most studies only assessed subjective financial strain or limited NMDOH domains. Future instruments should integrate multidimensional financial toxicity and NMDOH measures with caregiver role formation.
items.curatedReason: 当前卒中照护者评估在财务负担和非医疗健康因素方面存在不足。您在评估卒中照护者能力时，应考虑纳入多维度的财务毒性和更全面的非医疗健康因素，以识别脆弱性并提供公平支持。
items.titleZh: 卒中后早期照护角色形成中的财务负担、非医疗健康因素：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16 项研究的范围综述发现，卒中照护者评估未能一致地捕捉财务毒性和非医疗健康决定因素。大多数研究仅评估主观财务压力或有限的非医疗健康领域。未来的评估工具应整合多维度的财务毒性和非医疗健康措施，并结合照护者角色形成。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current stroke caregiver assessments are inadequate regarding financial burden and non-medical drivers of health. When evaluating stroke caregiver capacity, you should consider including multidimensional financial toxicity and more comprehensive non-medical health factors to identify vulnerabilities and provide equitable support.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，无法量化具体影响或提供干预效果的比较。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review and cannot quantify specific impacts or compare intervention effectiveness.

items.title: The effect of adding virtual reality-based rehabilitation to conventional physiotherapy on pain, function and static balance control in patients with total knee arthroplasty during the acute rehabilitation phase: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=52) found that adding VR-based therapy to conventional physiotherapy after total knee arthroplasty significantly improved WOMAC scores and pain at post-treatment and one-month follow-up (p < 0.001, η² = 0.36), and static balance (p < 0.001, η² = 0.23 for mediolateral mean velocity) compared to conventional therapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 在全膝关节置换术（TKA）的急性康复期，虚拟现实（VR）疗法能额外改善患者的疼痛、功能和静态平衡。这提示您可考虑将 VR 引入 TKA 术后早期康复方案，作为传统物理治疗的补充。
items.titleZh: 在全膝关节置换术急性康复期，将虚拟现实康复加入常规物理治疗对疼痛、功能和静态平衡控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=52）发现，在全膝关节置换术后，与单独的常规物理治疗相比，在常规物理治疗中加入基于虚拟现实的疗法能显著改善治疗后和一个月随访时的 WOMAC 评分和疼痛（p < 0.001, η² = 0.36），以及静态平衡（p < 0.001, 内外侧平均速度 η² = 0.23）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Virtual reality (VR) therapy can provide additional benefits in pain, function, and static balance during the acute rehabilitation phase following total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This suggests you might consider incorporating VR into early post-TKA rehabilitation programs as a supplement to conventional physiotherapy.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心小样本研究（52 名患者），随访期短，且未评估长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study with a small sample size (52 patients), short follow-up, and did not assess long-term efficacy.

items.title: Promoting arm movement practice with a novel wheelchair armrest early after stroke: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=35) found that a novel wheelchair-mounted rehabilitation device, Boost, was feasible and allowed stroke inpatients to complete thousands of unsupervised upper extremity movements. While no significant between-group clinical differences were found at 3-month follow-up, the Boost group showed a trend toward greater UEFM improvement immediately post-intervention (11.8 vs. 6.9 points, p = 0.06), especially for those with less severe impairment.
items.curatedReason: 新型轮椅扶手辅助设备 Boost 在卒中早期住院康复中能促进患者完成数千次上肢运动，对轻度损伤患者短期效果更佳。这提示您可考虑引入此类设备，增加患者在无直接监督下的运动量，从而优化康复效率，尤其对于损伤程度较轻的患者。
items.titleZh: 卒中早期使用新型轮椅扶手辅助促进手臂运动训练：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=35）发现，新型轮椅辅助康复设备 Boost 在卒中住院患者中可行，并使其在无监督下完成数千次上肢运动。虽然 3 个月随访时未发现显著的组间临床差异，但 Boost 组在干预后上肢 Fugl-Meyer 评分有更大改善趋势（11.8 vs. 6.9 分, p = 0.06），尤其对轻度损伤患者更明显。
items.curatedReasonEn: The novel wheelchair armrest device, Boost, can facilitate thousands of upper extremity movements in early post-stroke inpatient rehabilitation, with better short-term outcomes for less severely impaired patients. This suggests you could consider incorporating such devices to increase patient exercise volume without direct supervision, optimizing rehabilitation efficiency, especially for those with less severe impairment.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（35 名患者），随访期短，且未达到显著的组间临床差异，尚需更大规模 RCT 验证。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (35 patients), short follow-up, and did not achieve significant between-group clinical differences, necessitating validation in larger RCTs.

items.title: Extracting meaningful features from time series analysis of plasma analytes in clinical research
items.summary: This study explores extracting meaningful features from time series analysis of plasma enzymes in ambulatory inpatients with Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophies. It found that enzyme levels increased after physical activity and then decreased, suggesting muscle damage and subsequent clearance, which could indicate sarcolemma fragility.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，肌源性血浆酶的时间序列分析可能为肌萎缩症患者的肌膜脆性和肌肉损伤提供有价值的指标。这提示您在评估患者时，未来或许可以通过动态生物标志物来补充传统的功能评估。
items.titleZh: 从肌萎缩症患者血浆分析物时间序列分析中提取有意义的特征
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探索了从肢带型肌营养不良症住院患者血浆酶时间序列分析中提取有意义的特征。研究发现，体力活动后酶水平升高随后下降，提示肌肉损伤和随后的清除，这可能指示肌膜脆性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that time series analysis of muscle-derived plasma enzymes could provide valuable indicators for sarcolemma fragility and muscle damage in muscular dystrophies. This implies that in the future, you might be able to supplement traditional functional assessments with dynamic biomarker analysis when evaluating patients.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量未明确提及，且为初步的机制探索，结论需在临床大样本中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The sample size for this study was not clearly mentioned, and as a preliminary mechanistic exploration, its conclusions need further validation in larger clinical cohorts.

items.title: Effects of training with a soft wearable robot (Myosuit®) on the walking ability of patients with chronic stroke
items.summary: A randomized controlled study (N=30) found that gait training using Myosuit®, a soft wearable robot, did not show overall significant differences compared to a control group in chronic stroke patients. However, subgroup analysis showed significant improvements in the 10-m walking test, Berg balance scale, and gait velocity for Myosuit® users with better baseline gait function (FAC 4).
items.curatedReason: 使用软性可穿戴机器人 Myosuit® 进行步态训练可能对慢性卒中、且步态功能较好的患者的步态功能有改善作用。这提示您在引入康复机器人时，应考虑患者的基线步态功能水平，以实现更精准的干预。
items.titleZh: 使用软性可穿戴机器人（Myosuit®）训练对慢性卒中患者步行能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照研究（N=30）发现，与对照组相比，使用软性可穿戴机器人 Myosuit® 进行步态训练对慢性卒中患者总体上未显示显著差异。然而，亚组分析显示，基线步态功能较好（FAC 4）的 Myosuit® 使用者在 10 米步行测试、Berg 平衡量表和步速方面有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Gait training with the soft wearable robot Myosuit® may improve gait function in chronic stroke patients with better baseline gait function. This suggests that when introducing rehabilitation robots, you should consider patients' baseline gait function levels for more precise interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（30 名患者），且总体结果未见显著差异，仅在亚组分析中显示出效应。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (30 patients), showed no significant overall differences, and only revealed effects in subgroup analysis.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Association Between Early Postoperative Limb Symmetry Index Scores and 2-Year Patient-Reported Outcomes After Quadriceps Tendon Autograft ACL Reconstruction.
items.summary: A case series of 100 patients after QT-ACLR showed that early 3-month isometric quadriceps LSI strongly predicted 2-year IKDC scores (β = 3.9; Adj R² = 0.36; P < .03), with patients achieving PASS typically reaching a 60%-70% LSI by 3 months.
items.curatedReason: 对于 QT-ACLR 术后患者，早期等长股四头肌 LSI 值是 2 年 IKDC 评分的强预测因子。这条观察性研究提示，3 个月时能达到 60%-70% LSI 的患者，更有可能在两年后获得满意的功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 股四头肌肌腱自体移植 ACL 重建术后早期肢体对称性指数与 2 年患者报告结局的相关性
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 例股四头肌肌腱自体移植 ACL 重建患者的病例系列研究显示，术后 3 个月早期等长股四头肌肢体对称性指数（LSI）能强力预测 2 年 IKDC 评分（β = 3.9; 校正 R² = 0.36; P < .03），达到患者可接受症状状态（PASS）的患者通常在 3 个月时 LSI 达到 60%-70%。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients post-QT-ACLR, early isometric quadriceps LSI strongly predicts 2-year IKDC scores. This observational study suggests that achieving 60%-70% LSI by 3 months is associated with a greater likelihood of satisfactory functional recovery at two years.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性病例系列，可能存在选择偏倚，且随访时长中位数 2 年。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center retrospective case series, which may introduce selection bias, and the median follow-up duration was 2 years.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=75) on post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome found that high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises produced significantly greater improvements in nerve conduction velocity, CMAP amplitudes, and DASH scores compared to extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) or exercises alone, with benefits maintained at 12-week follow-up (all P < .001).
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验明确指出，联合尺神经滑行训练，高强度激光治疗（HILT）在改善烧伤后肘管综合征的电生理和功能结局方面优于体外冲击波治疗（ESWT）。该证据支持您在临床实践中，对于此类患者优先考虑 HILT 治疗。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后肘管综合征高强度激光治疗与体外冲击波治疗的电生理及功能反应比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对烧伤后肘管综合征的随机对照试验（n=75）发现，高强度激光治疗（HILT）联合尺神经滑行训练在神经传导速度、复合肌肉动作电位幅度和 DASH 评分方面，比体外冲击波治疗（ESWT）或单纯运动治疗产生显著更大的改善，且益处在 12 周随访时仍保持（所有 P < .001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial clearly indicates that high-intensity laser therapy (HILT), combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises, is superior to extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) in improving electrophysiological and functional outcomes for post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome. This evidence supports prioritizing HILT for such patients in your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心试验，随访期仅为 12 周，长期效果尚需更多证据。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center trial with a follow-up period of only 12 weeks, so long-term effects require further evidence.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Can Psychological Readiness Predict Successful Return to Sports After Patellar Stabilization Surgery in Adolescent Patients? A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 97 adolescent patients found that an ACL-RSI score ≥59.2 was associated with a 3.56 odds ratio (95% CI, 1.10-11.51; P = .033) for successful return to sport after patellar stabilization surgery.
items.curatedReason: ACL-RSI 量表对髌骨稳定术后青少年患者能否成功重返运动具有预测价值，总分 ≥59.2 是成功的预测因素。这提示您在术后康复中，除了身体功能，应将患者的心理准备状态纳入评估。
items.titleZh: 心理准备程度能否预测青少年髌骨稳定术后成功重返运动？一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 97 名青少年患者的回顾性队列研究发现，ACL-RSI 评分 ≥59.2 与髌骨稳定术后成功重返运动的几率增加（比值比 3.56；95% CI，1.10-11.51；P = .033）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ACL-RSI scale has predictive value for successful return to sport after patellar stabilization surgery in adolescent patients, with a score ≥59.2 indicating success. This suggests you should integrate the patient's psychological readiness into your postoperative rehabilitation assessment, beyond just physical function.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且为单中心研究，结果可能存在选择偏倚和外推性限制。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study was conducted at a single institution, which may introduce selection bias and limit generalizability.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access in a referral-based system in Austria - A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 10 Austrian physiotherapists identified that while informal direct access is common, barriers to formal implementation include concerns about red-flag screening, legal uncertainty, and interprofessional relationships, highlighting needs for targeted training.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究揭示了奥地利物理治疗师对直接就诊的看法，指出了在现有转诊体系下，尽管存在非正式的直接就诊实践，但在红旗征象筛查、法律责任和医患关系方面仍有培训需求和组织障碍。
items.titleZh: 奥地利转诊体系中物理治疗师对直接就诊的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 10 名奥地利物理治疗师的定性研究发现，尽管非正式的直接就诊已存在，但正式实施的障碍包括对红旗征象筛查、法律不确定性和医患关系的担忧，凸显了定向培训的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals Austrian physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access, indicating that while informal direct access exists within the referral system, there are still training needs and organizational barriers related to red-flag screening, legal liability, and physician-patient relationships.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索性研究，样本量小（10 名物理治疗师），结果主要反映受访者的主观感知。

items.title: Clarifying 'youth: why conceptual and ethical clarity matters in sport
items.summary: This editorial highlights the conceptual and ethical issues arising from the variable terminology used to define 'youth' athletes in sport, arguing that adopted labels carry embedded assumptions about capacities, rights, and risks.

items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial calls for definitional clarity around “youth” in sport, reminding you to consider the assumptions about capacities, rights, and risks that different terminologies might carry when assessing and managing young athletes.

items.summary: This editorial highlights the Women's Tennis Association's Fertility Protection Programme for professional female tennis players, addressing distinct barriers to high-performance sport across their lifespan, including fertility preservation and return-to-sport challenges.

items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial introduces the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) Fertility Protection Programme, revealing the unique fertility challenges and support needs of female athletes. items.title: 'Written in English: has English as the lingua franca of mental health research in sport and parasport become a barrier to creating culturally and contextually situated mental health care?

items.title: Implementation gap: a 3-year reality check in body composition monitoring in sport
items.summary: This editorial addresses the implementation gap in body composition monitoring in sport, three years after the International Olympic Committee's recommendations on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs) were published, advocating for better translation of evidence into practice.

items.titleZh: 实施差距：运动中身体成分监测的三年现实检查
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论讨论了运动中身体成分监测的实施差距，指出国际奥委会关于运动性相对能量不足综合征（REDs）的建议发布三年后，实践中仍存在不足，呼吁更好地将证据转化为实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial highlights an implementation gap in body composition monitoring recommendations for athletes three years after the IOC Consensus Statement. items.title: 'Avoid vigorous exercise until further notice: recovery after cholesteatoma surgery
items.summary: This commentary reflects on an amateur powerlifter's experience with vague post-cholesteatoma surgery restrictions, highlighting the lack of clear timelines or explanations for 'avoid vigorous exercise' and its impact on mental and physical well-being.

items.curatedReasonEn: This personal account explores an athlete's confusion and uncertainty regarding the 'avoid vigorous exercise' instruction after cholesteatoma surgery. This reminds you that when providing post-operative or injury recovery advice, you must offer clear, specific, and time-bound guidance, and engage in shared decision-making with patients to meet their individual needs and goals.

items.title: Influence of shoulder strength on throwing velocity in handball (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A PhD study developed a functional shoulder dynamogram to define how comprehensive shoulder strength profiles influence throwing velocity in handball players, assessing the reliability of novel measurement protocols and exploring the capacity of specific concentric and eccentric muscle actions to predict performance.

items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing handball throwing velocity, don't just look at overall strength. This PhD study suggests specific concentric and eccentric shoulder muscle actions predict performance. Use this to develop more refined biomechanical assessments and targeted training programs.

items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD study suggests there are sex differences in performance fatigability mechanisms after maximal intermittent fatigue. This means you must consider biological sex when designing training and rehabilitation programs to ensure individualized interventions.

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A multicenter randomized controlled trial found that a smartphone-based digital therapeutic combining personalized exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy significantly reduced pain and improved function, quality of life, and psychological well-being in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心 RCT 表明，结合运动疗法和认知行为疗法的数字疗法，对慢性髌股关节疼痛患者的疼痛缓解和功能改善是有效且可规模化的。你可以在临床实践中考虑推荐这类数字工具，以提高患者依从性并解决心理社会因素。
items.titleZh: 结合运动与认知行为疗法的数字疗法可减轻慢性髌股关节疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验

items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter RCT shows that a digital therapeutic combining exercise therapy and cognitive-behavioral therapy is effective and scalable for pain reduction and functional improvement in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain. items.title: Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation Improves Motor Function of Upper Extremity in Adults with Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial showed that transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercises significantly improved upper-limb motor function (FMA-UE MD = 3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69) and shoulder and elbow muscle strength in chronic ischemic stroke patients compared to sham stimulation.
items.curatedReason: taVNS 联合上肢运动可能是慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢功能恢复的新辅助手段。FMA-UE 提高 3.95 分（95% CI 0.21-7.69）虽达统计学显著，但需警惕其临床意义是否足以改变实践。鉴于样本量有限，现在就引入临床还为时过早，但值得后续更多研究验证。
items.titleZh: 经皮迷走神经刺激改善慢性缺血性卒中成人上肢运动功能：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）结合上肢运动训练，与假刺激相比，能显著改善慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢运动功能（FMA-UE MD = 3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69）以及肩肘肌肉力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: taVNS combined with upper limb exercises might be a new adjunct for upper limb recovery in chronic ischemic stroke patients. While a 3.95-point FMA-UE improvement (95% CI 0.21-7.69) is statistically significant, question whether this truly translates to clinically meaningful changes. Given the limited sample size, it's too early to implement, but keep an eye on future larger trials.
items.limitation: FMA-UE 评分的 95% 置信区间低于报告的最小临床重要差异，其临床意义需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The 95% CI for FMA-UE score was below the reported minimal clinically important difference, so its clinical relevance should be interpreted cautiously.

items.title: Sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 216 elite TeamGym gymnasts established sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance, including hop for distance, side-hop, and heel-raise, finding significant sex × age-group interactions for hop outcomes and males outperforming females in heel raises.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究首次为精英 TeamGym 体操运动员提供了下肢功能测试的性别和年龄特异性常模，弥补了该领域的数据空白。这些基准值对你评估运动员康复进展和重返运动能力，尤其是针对跳跃和提踵表现，有直接的指导意义。
items.titleZh: 精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢场地测试的性别和年龄特异性常模
items.summaryZh: 一项对 216 名精英 TeamGym 体操运动员进行的横断面研究，建立了下肢功能表现（包括跳远、侧跳和提踵）的性别和年龄特异性常模。研究发现，跳跃表现存在显著的性别×年龄组交互作用，且男性在提踵次数上优于女性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides the first sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts, filling a data gap. These benchmarks directly guide your assessment of athlete rehabilitation progress and return-to-sport capability, especially for hop and heel-raise performance.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法追踪运动员表现随时间的变化或评估这些常模预测损伤的有效性。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents tracking changes in athlete performance over time or evaluating the predictive validity of these norms for injury.
